kammakilesa.p: [Kamma+kilesa] (pu) CL=7 (A) Kamma (deed). Kilesa. (In this the will as per Kamma. Takes 10 factors of Kilesa as per Kilesa). (B) Kamma that causes worry. (Four factors of Kamma that are Pāṇātipāta (killing another's life), adinnādāna(stealing another object), kāmesumicchācāra (intercourse with another wife), musāvāda (say lie)).
